question:
An NPN transistor is used as a low-side switch to drive a load resistor $R_L=148\,\Omega$ connected from $+12\,\text{V}$ to the collector. The emitter is grounded.

When ON (saturated), take $V_{CE(sat)}=0.2\,\text{V}$ and $V_{BE(sat)}=0.8\,\text{V}$. To ensure saturation, use a forced gain $\beta_f=10$ (i.e., $I_B\ge I_C/10$).

The base is driven from a $5.0\,\text{V}$ logic output through a resistor $R_B$.

Estimate $R_B$.
